claims.text: YC-7: a customer's refund request is accepted and answered within 2 seconds, even when the payment gateway does not answer or returns an error.

refund-design.md rejects calling the gateway inside the customer's request: simpler (no status column, no job), but when the gateway fails or is slow the customer waits, gets an error and the request is not recorded, against YC-7.

system-design-method.md's six sample challenges: gateway in request (YC-7); two-phase commit (ADR 0003, refund-design.md); gateway down two days (YC-10, YC-6); refunded twice (YC-9, key refund-<id>); no idempotency key (risk R2); maximum days after payment (not known, open question).
The method's rule: a challenge that shows a driver has changed reopens the decision with a new ADR, instead of defending the old decision in the review.
Risk R2 in refund-design.md: if the gateway does not accept an idempotency key, step 4 must change to asking the refund status before each resend.

refund-requirements.md open questions table has columns question, who answers, deadline; the maximum-days and bank-transfer questions are answered by the gateway provider and asked by the product owner.
ADR 0003 context: the gateway API key and the money rows are the most sensitive part of the system; consequences include one more service to run and order and refund agreeing only after a while.
Refund estimate in system-design-method.md: 12,000 orders in the busiest hour (from capacity-plan.md) times a 1% refund share (assumed) is about 120 refunds, about 0.03 a second.

refund-design.md step 3: Payments writes the message id into inbox_messages in the same transaction, so a repeated message creates no second row; a unique index on order_id for refund rows also blocks it. Step 3 cites YC-8 and YC-3, not YC-9; step 4 cites YC-9 (never refunded twice).
YC-2: a customer cannot request a refund for another person's order; refund-design.md step 1 has DonHang.Api check the order belongs to the caller (YC-2) before moving it to refunding.
Whether an order paid by bank transfer can be refunded through the gateway is an open question in refund-requirements.md; refund-design.md does not answer it.

An answer from preference cannot be checked by reviewers; an invented on-the-spot fix has not been weighed against the drivers; recording an uncovered case as open with an owner is the right answer when the design does not cover it.
